openQuestions: Q2 results (to September 2026, due by mid-November): does the gross margin recover from 24%, and how much of profit is exchange gains?
Does the Rs 4.5bn inventory build reverse, and are the new short-term loans repaid?
Will a dividend for 2025/26 be declared (last year's Rs 1.50 pre-split was paid in October)?
Copper price direction and its effect on stock values.
